qf6bbe40991.t: Every cycle, a single oocyte (it’s the one in the follicle that is becoming a tertiary follicle) will be selected to complete Meiosis 1 (metaphase, anaphase, telophase), but instead of forming two new daughters, we end up with one new daughter cell, secondary oocyte, and one polar body – this is the DNA that would have been inside the second daughter cell.

qf6bbe40991.src: Patton 9e · Ch 47 Growth and Development · p. 1093
qf6bbe40991.quote: meiotic division of the secondary oocyte produces a second polar body and a mature
qf6bbe40991.t: If fertilization does occur, however, then meiotic division of the secondary oocyte produces a second polar body and a mature, fertilized ovum called the zygote.
